| `ps2ur_debug_log` | `void(cstr message)` | UTF-8 message to the EE console at Info level. Diagnostic path; the per-call string copy is accepted (ADR-002 cstr rules). |
| `ps2ur_debug_overlay_set_page` | `void(i32 page)` | Selects the on-screen diagnostics page: 0 off, 1 frame timing, 2 profiler zones, 3 memory regions, 4 VRAM allocations. Select on the pad cycles the same pages; values out of range turn it off. |
| `ps2ur_debug_overlay_page` | `i32()` | The diagnostics page currently shown (see ps2ur_debug_overlay_set_page). |
| `ps2ur_entity_create` | `i32(i32 parentHandle)` | Creates a root entity (parentHandle 0) or a child. Returns the new handle, or 0 if the entity table is full. |
| `ps2ur_entity_destroy` | `void(i32 handle)` | Destroys the entity and its children. The handle's generation is retired: stale handles fail alive() forever after. |
| `ps2ur_entity_alive` | `i32(i32 handle)` | 1 if the handle refers to a live entity, else 0. This is the native truth behind Unity's destroyed-compares-null semantics. |
| `ps2ur_entity_set_active` | `void(i32 handle, i32 active)` | GameObject.SetActive: the renderer skips inactive subtrees. |
| `ps2ur_entity_get_active` | `i32(i32 handle)` | activeSelf (not the inherited activeInHierarchy). |

| `ps2ur_anim_update` | `void(f32 dt)` | Advances every animator by dt and writes their root motion back to entity transforms. The managed dispatcher calls this AFTER Update and coroutines and BEFORE LateUpdate, which is the ordering Unity users rely on (M9 task 4). |
| `ps2ur_animator_play` | `i32(i32 handle, u32 stateHash)` | Jumps the entity's animator to the named baked state with no blend. Returns 1 when the state exists, 0 otherwise. Names are FNV-1a-64 hashes truncated to 32 bits, matching the exporter. |
| `ps2ur_animator_crossfade` | `i32(i32 handle, u32 stateHash, f32 seconds)` | Starts a crossfade to the named state over a duration in SECONDS. Returns 1 when the state exists. |
| `ps2ur_animator_set_trigger` | `void(i32 handle, u32 paramHash)` |  |
| `ps2ur_animator_set_float` | `void(i32 handle, u32 paramHash, f32 value)` |  |
| `ps2ur_animator_is_blending` | `i32(i32 handle)` | 1 while a crossfade is running on the entity's animator. |
| `ps2ur_input_update` | `void()` | Polls every pad. The managed dispatcher calls this once at the top of the frame, before any script runs. |

| `ps2ur_input_button_down` | `i32(i32 port, i32 button)` |  |
| `ps2ur_input_button_up` | `i32(i32 port, i32 button)` |  |

| `ps2ur_input_pressure` | `i32(i32 port, i32 button)` | Analog button pressure, 0..255, or 0 when the pad does not report it. |
| `ps2ur_input_connected` | `i32(i32 port)` |  |
| `ps2ur_input_set_rumble` | `void(i32 port, i32 smallMotor, i32 largeMotor)` | Small motor is on/off; large motor takes 0..255. |
| `ps2ur_scene_load_begin` | `i32(cstr path, i32 additive)` | Starts an async scene load into the host-provided scene buffer (bridge::bind_scene_buffer). additive != 0 appends to the running world instead of replacing it. Returns 1 when the load started. Only one load is in flight at a time; starting a second while one runs is refused. |
| `ps2ur_scene_load_update` | `i32(i32 byteBudget)` | Advances the load by at most byteBudget bytes and returns the LoadState ordinal (0 Idle, 1 Reading, 2 Parsing, 3 Ready, 4 Failed). A budget of 0 means one chunk. |
| `ps2ur_scene_load_progress` | `f32()` | 0..1 across read and parse together -- what AsyncOperation.progress returns. |
| `ps2ur_scene_load_state` | `i32()` | The LoadState ordinal without advancing the load. |
| `ps2ur_scene_load_set_allow_activation` | `void(i32 allow)` | AsyncOperation.allowSceneActivation. 0 parks a completed read at progress 0.9 without swapping the world; setting it back to 1 lets the next update finish. Defaults to 1 on every begin. |
| `ps2ur_phys_step` | `void()` | Advances the physics world by one fixed step against the scene's own transforms. The managed dispatcher calls this from its FixedUpdate loop, before FixedUpdate scripts run. |

| `ps2ur_phys_fixed_timestep` | `f32()` | Time.fixedDeltaTime as the solver sees it. |
| `ps2ur_phys_set_fixed_timestep` | `void(f32 dt)` |  |

| `ps2ur_phys_spherecast` | `i32(f32 originX, f32 originY, f32 originZ, f32 radius, f32 dirX, f32 dirY, f32 dirZ, f32 maxDistance, i32 mask, P2RaycastHit* hit)` | Physics.SphereCast, same contract as the raycast above. |
| `ps2ur_phys_overlap_sphere` | `i32(f32 x, f32 y, f32 z, f32 radius, i32 mask)` | Physics.OverlapSphere. Runs the query, keeps the result in a native scratch list and returns how many were FOUND -- which may exceed what the list can hold, so a caller can tell it was truncated. Read the entries with ps2ur_phys_overlap_result. |
| `ps2ur_phys_overlap_result` | `i32(i32 index)` | Collider index from the last overlap query, or -1 when the index is past what the scratch list actually holds. |
| `ps2ur_phys_contact_count` | `i32()` | Contacts produced by the last step. The managed dispatcher reads the whole list in ONE interop call per frame (M11 task 3) rather than one call per event. |

| `ps2ur_phys_contacts_dropped` | `i32()` | Contacts that did not fit this frame. Non-zero means the game is silently missing events, and the runtime says so rather than hiding it. |

| `ps2ur_phys_body_get_velocity` | `void(i32 body, P2Vec3* value)` |  |
| `ps2ur_phys_body_add_force` | `void(i32 body, f32 x, f32 y, f32 z)` | Rigidbody.AddForce in Force mode; the accumulator is cleared each step. |

Looping is baked into the clip at encode. When 'spatial' is nonzero the voice registers for per-frame pan/attenuation against the entity named by 'entity_handle' (M12.5 task 2). |

| `ps2ur_ui_set_rect` | `void(i32 element, f32 x, f32 y, f32 w, f32 h)` | Moves/resizes an element in screen pixels, top-left origin. Layout was baked at export; this is how scripts (and the Slider fill) animate it. |
| `ps2ur_ui_get_colour` | `u32(i32 element)` | The element's CURRENT tint, RGBA8 with alpha in the PS2 0..0x80 range. CreateUIGraphic seeds the managed Graphic from this so the focus highlight can restore the AUTHORED colour, not an assumed white. Out-of-range elements return opaque white. |
| `ps2ur_ui_set_colour` | `void(i32 element, u32 rgba)` | Tint, RGBA8 with alpha already in the PS2 0..0x80 range. Graphic.color and the navigation focus highlight write through this. |
| `ps2ur_ui_set_text` | `void(i32 element, cstr text)` | Replaces a text element's string (48-byte cap, baked 8x8 font). cstr on a set-on-change path, not per frame. |
| `ps2ur_ui_set_text_glow` | `void(i32 element, f32 spread, f32 intensity, f32 dilate)` | Console-side bloom for a text element: the glyph run is drawn again in a ring of 'spread' pixels, additively at 'intensity' (0..1) of its alpha, under the crisp run; 'dilate' (0..1) widens the inner ring. 0 intensity is plain text. PS2BootGlowText's UNITY_PS2 branch drives it. |
| `ps2ur_ui_set_visible` | `void(i32 element, i32 visible)` | Shows/hides an element; Behaviour.enabled on the managed graphics. |
